args.script:
phone.open("Settings")
phone.wait(2500)
phone.tap(phone.waitFor({ text = "Network & internet" }, 8000))
phone.wait(2500)
phone.tap(phone.waitFor({ text = "Adaptive connectivity" }, 8000))
phone.wait(2500)

local q = { id = "switch_widget" }
local t = phone.waitFor(q, 8000)
if not t then phone.log("NO-TOGGLE") return "none" end
phone.log("start=" .. tostring(t.checked))

local function state()
  local node = phone.find(q)
  if node then return tostring(node.checked) end
  return "gone"
end

-- Into the state it is already in. A recorded list of taps would flip it; this must not.
local _, why = phone.ensure(q, t.checked)
phone.log("same=" .. why)

-- And the other way, which must tap.
local _, why2 = phone.ensure(q, not t.checked)
phone.log("flip=" .. why2)
phone.wait(2500)
phone.log("after=" .. state())

-- Put it back, so the task leaves the phone as it found it.
local _, why3 = phone.ensure(q, t.checked)
phone.log("back=" .. why3)
phone.wait(2500)
phone.log("final=" .. state())

return "toggle-ok"
